name: 风暴奔行者号
description: 大型木质蒸汽飞艇，以三根桅杆及可收放船帆提供主要升力与航行动力，船尾下方的黄铜螺旋桨持续推进；通过机械船舵、齿轮拉杆与罗盘控制航向，运行时伴随螺旋桨转动、索具绷紧、木结构吱嘎与机械齿轮声。

variants.appearance: 大型木质空中帆船，设有三根木制桅杆、横桁间展开的白色船帆、复杂索具与栏杆，船尾下方安装黄铜螺旋桨。
variants.stage1_prompt: Airborne pirate vessel: elongated needle like moderately slender wooden hull, low freeboard, straight weighty prow, compact stepped sterncastle, continuous gun deck, shallow tapered belly. Three raked masts with layered sails and rigging. Three compact lift intakes per flank with short brass lips and low aft angled exhaust cowls. Lower hull opens into one long ribbed mechanical bay; outer keel and hull line remain continuous. Curved timber and brass ribs frame integrated fantasy lift machinery: counter rotating flywheels, pressure drums, piston banks, geared vanes, central turbine shaft. Machinery links side intakes to segmented downward keel vents and modest stern propellers. Three quarter side view showing sleek proportions, ribbed machinery bay, lift units, railings, gunports, and hatches. Crisp varied width monochrome ink on white paper, clear graphic shapes, minimal texture, neutral background, no color. --ar 16:9
